# The guest floor: everything in the guest that engineering has no access to
# (owner, 2026-10-25 Q2). One repo-relative path per line; a directory covers
# everything under it, so a package is listed as its whole directory (files it
# embeds and generated files are covered). Tests (*_test.go) and testdata/ are
# left out of the hash by flake.nix: they are not in the binaries.
#
# The floor_digest in a guest image's release.json hashes the contents of
# these paths (docs/design/density-d2-snapshots-survive-deploys-2026-10-26.md
# 3.1). It over-approximates on purpose: a wrongly counted floor change only
# costs a cold boot. scripts/check-guest-floor-paths fails CI when a package
# the floor commands import is not covered by this list. Add a path here in
# the commit that makes the floor depend on it.

# build recipe and pins: the floor binaries and the image are built by
# mkGoService, commonGoArgs and mkGuestImage in flake.nix
flake.nix
flake.lock
go.mod
go.sum

# the guest NixOS module and the scripts it reads
nix/autoputer-vm.nix
scripts/guest-signer-state-migrate
scripts/guest-signer-state-project

# the floor commands (the guest's Choir binaries other than autoputer)
cmd/capsule-broker
cmd/choir-capture
cmd/choir-delegate
cmd/choir-receipt-signer
cmd/choir-updater

# every Choir package those commands import (GOOS=linux go list -deps)
internal/agentprofile
internal/base/blob
internal/base/journal
internal/base/model
internal/base/tree
internal/buildinfo
internal/capsule
internal/capsulejob
internal/claudedelegate
internal/coagentpacket
internal/computerevent
internal/computerversion
internal/deskmanifest
internal/hostlink
internal/mirrorgrant
internal/normtext
internal/quotematch
internal/receiptsigner
internal/sourcecontract
internal/sourcefetch
internal/steptrace
internal/storeschema
internal/texturedoc
internal/texturewrite
internal/types
internal/updater
internal/verifierprotocol
internal/visualcapture
internal/vocabmigrate
internal/yaegikernel
